爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 AHR019 水田新奈Mizuta Nina-被风吹乱的勇气 2026.02.22
心脏狂跳着追上她，风掀起裙摆上的鸢尾花。
“打扰一下…”她回头时眼睛像琥珀。
刚鼓起的勇气被风抢先——她转身按住翻飞的裙摆，发丝扫过我的肩膀。
我瞬间忘了词，只幻想牵着这只手走过所有盛夏的黄昏。
“能帮个忙吗？”
我捏住飘落的披肩穗子，突然希望这阵风永远别停。
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink AHR019 Mizuta Nina-Courage Disordered by the Wind 2026.02.22
My heart pounded as I caught up with her, the wind lifting the irises on her skirt.
"Excuse me..." she said, her eyes like amber as she turned.
The courage I'd just mustered was snatched away by the wind~
She turned and pressed down on her fluttering skirt, strands of hair brushing my shoulder.
I instantly forgot what to say, only imagining holding her hand through every summer evening.
"Could you do me a favor?"
I clutched the falling tassel of her shawl, suddenly wishing this wind would never stop.
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone
